stock_chart.rsi_tooltip_beginner: A speed limit gauge for stock prices. Above 70 means it's running too hot (Overbought), below 30 means it's heavily sold (Oversold).
stock_chart.rsi_tooltip_pro: Relative Strength Index (RSI) measures the speed and magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overvalued or undervalued conditions.
stock_chart.trend_tooltip_beginner: Shows the general direction the stock is heading. 'Upward' means buyers are currently in control.
stock_chart.trend_tooltip_pro: Moving Average based trend detection analyzing momentum shifts and prevailing price direction.
stock_chart.rsi_desc_beginner_high: The price has gone up too fast recently. It might be slightly expensive right now.
stock_chart.rsi_desc_beginner_low: The stock has been sold heavily. It might be cheap, but be careful.
stock_chart.rsi_desc_beginner_neutral: The stock price is moving at a normal, healthy pace.
stock_chart.rsi_desc_pro_high: Elevated RSI suggests potential overvaluation. Consider trailing stop.
stock_chart.rsi_desc_pro_low: Low RSI indicates oversold conditions. Watch for reversal patterns.
stock_chart.rsi_desc_pro_neutral: RSI neutral range. No immediate momentum signal.
stock_chart.trend_desc_beginner_up: The stock is generally going up. Buyers are in control.
stock_chart.trend_desc_beginner_down: The stock is going down. Sellers are in control right now.
stock_chart.trend_desc_beginner_side: The stock isn't moving much in either direction.
stock_chart.trend_desc_pro_up: Consistent upward channel. MA crossover confirms bullish momentum.
stock_chart.trend_desc_pro_down: Downward pressure with bearish MA alignment. Risk elevated.

risk_card.condition_beginner_high: This stock has been going up very quickly. It might be too expensive right now. Consider waiting for the price to come down a bit.
risk_card.condition_beginner_low: This stock has dropped a lot recently. It could be a good deal, but make sure to do your research first before buying.
risk_card.condition_beginner_neutral: Everything looks normal right now. The stock isn't too expensive or too cheap.
risk_card.condition_pro_high: RSI at {{rsi}} indicates overbought conditions.{{pe}} Consider profit-taking or tightening stops.
risk_card.condition_pro_low: RSI at {{rsi}} signals oversold territory. If fundamentals hold, this may present a value entry point. Confirm with volume analysis.
risk_card.condition_pro_neutral: RSI {{rsi}}: neutral range.{{volatility}} No extreme conditions detected. Standard position sizing recommended.

ai_insight_card.disclaimer: This advice is generated by AI based on current market data. Always do your own research before making any investment decisions.

warning_banner.low_rsi: This stock shows a very low RSI ({{value}}), suggesting heavy selling pressure. Do not assume an automatic rebound.
